artefacts.title: Stakeholder Map — T3 PM job (Phase A, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: Identify the requester, the approver, the programme roles and the boundaries whose needs and constraints shape the PM job.
artefacts.scope: T3's direct stakeholders; S05 appears only as the boundary that owns project creation and the board surfaces.

value.objective: Runs a request end to end: charter, plan, baseline, change and closure.
value.detail: The PM requests every gate and is never its requester-side approver; SPEC_V2 §12 T3's first clause is proved by the close gate's distinct-approver rule.

value.objective: Decides every PM gate, always distinct from the requester.
value.detail: approvals.decide records decided_by and via.delegation_ref; the closing rule refuses self-approval (`the taker cannot approve their own baseline` in programme_baseline).

value.objective: Owns delivery and the tranche record.
value.detail: Reads the baseline, the closure gate and the closure review; the tr3 review is the tranche's decision.

value.objective: Owns the baseline's architecture content.
value.detail: The scope baseline's architecture content and the delivery contract's design are the architect's; the Board approves the contract.

value.objective: Approves the T3 delivery contract under the standing delegation.
value.detail: architecture.board_decide records an approval_decision with decided_by_kind='rule' and via.delegation_ref.

value.objective: Reviews the tranche; the review authorises the next.
value.detail: tranches.review continue closes the tranche and authorises the next; a paused or stopped tranche authorises nothing.

value.objective: Holds the tenant's scopes and RLS.
value.detail: Every row the PM job writes is tenant-scoped with FORCE RLS; the close gate reads the same tenant only.

value.objective: Owns project creation and the board surfaces.
value.detail: T3 consumes projects and boards but does not build them; the boundary is declared in the SoAW's scope.

artefacts.title: Driver/Goal/Objective Catalogue — T3 PM job (Phase A, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: Record why the PM job exists and what it must achieve: a request end to end, dual control on every gate, and change only through a change request.
artefacts.scope: The T3 slice as SPEC_V2 §12 defines it and the manifest's checks execute it.

value.objective: The PM runs a request end to end.
value.detail: pm.plan and projects.baseline write the WBS and the scope baseline; the five deliverables carry WSJF inputs and accepted status.

value.objective: The PM cannot approve its own gate.
value.detail: Every PM gate is decided by an actor other than its requester; the closure gate refuses a self-approved decision.

value.objective: A baseline change requires a change request.
value.detail: A change is an approved `change` register row with an impact block and its own gate; a self-declared approved change cannot advance a baseline (`a_self_declared_approved_change_cannot_advance_a_baseline`).

value.objective: The close reads the record, not prose.
value.detail: projects.close runs assert_project_can_close: published outputs, approved closure gate, distinct approver, tranche authorisation, charter, scope/schedule/cost baselines, the live contract and its Phase-G review.

value.objective: Every decision is a row.
value.detail: approval_decision records the approver, the kind and the delegation; the closure review and the contract cite it.

value.objective: A close cannot outrun its tranche.
value.detail: The closure gate refuses a project whose tranche is not authorised (`a_project_outside_its_programme_tranche_plan_cannot_start`).

artefacts.title: Requirements Catalogue — T3 PM job (Phase A, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: State the functional and non-functional requirements the PM job must satisfy, with the proof each demands.
artefacts.scope: The PM request-to-plan path, the four PM gates, the change path and the closure — the subjects the manifest's checks execute.

value.objective: pm.plan writes the WBS and the scope baseline in one transaction.
value.detail: Proved by `programme_baseline::all_three_kinds_are_taken_and_read_back` and the T3 manifest's T3-baseline check.

value.objective: The charter gate is approved before the project can be planned.
value.detail: plan_project refuses `charter_not_approved`; the T3-charter check reads the charter asset and the gate.

value.objective: A baseline is approved by a distinct reviewer.
value.detail: `the taker cannot approve their own baseline`; `a_distinct_reviewer_approves_only_once`.

value.objective: A change carries an impact block and cannot be born approved.
value.detail: `a_change_with_no_impact_analysis_is_refused`, `a_change_status_cannot_be_written_approved`, `a_change_impact_cannot_be_stripped_by_an_update`.

value.objective: projects.close_request opens a closure gate; projects.close refuses without the record.
value.detail: `closure_gate.rs` deletes the published evidence and the close is refused; the T3-closure-gate check reads the distinct approver.

value.objective: A gate is opened with typed evidence or an explicit waiver.
value.detail: `an_evidence_less_gate_is_refused`, `a_gate_with_evidence_opens`, `an_explicit_evidence_waiver_is_recorded`.

value.objective: Every row and every gate is tenant-scoped.
value.detail: FORCE RLS on the PM tables; `a_foreign_tenant_cannot_approve`.

value.objective: A project cannot start or close outside its tranche's authorisation.
value.detail: `a_project_outside_its_programme_tranche_plan_cannot_start`; the close gate's `closure_tranche_not_authorised`.

artefacts.title: Solution Concept Diagram — T3 PM job (Phase A, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: Show the PM path's components and the flows between them: request, gate, decide, baseline, change, close.
artefacts.scope: The T3 slice only; project creation and the board surfaces belong to S05.

value.objective: Writes WBS nodes, takes the baseline and opens its approval in one transaction.
value.detail: plan_project: charter gate, baseline_change_guard, WBS inserts, take_baseline_linked.

value.objective: Poses each gate and records each decision.
value.detail: The approval row carries gate, target, evidence; the decision carries decided_by, decided_by_kind and via.delegation_ref.

value.objective: Refuses a baseline replacement without an approved change.
value.detail: Reads the change register row, its impact block and its own gate before any WBS write.

value.objective: Opens the closure gate, then closes on the record.
value.detail: close_request opens `projects.close` with the closure asset; close runs assert_project_can_close.

value.objective: The close gate's one authority.
value.detail: Outputs published, gate approved by a distinct actor, asset approved, charter, baselines, contract and Phase-G review, mandatory artefacts, no open P0.

value.objective: Every verb is registered, schema-validated and tenant-scoped.
value.detail: The action macro declares scopes, effects and approval targets; the invoke boundary validates input before the handler.

value.objective: One tenant-scoped store for the whole path.
value.detail: FORCE RLS; migrations carry the constraints the PM gates read.

artefacts.title: Business Capability Map — T3 PM job (Phase B, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: Name the capabilities the PM job establishes and the outcome each delivers.
artefacts.scope: The capabilities delivered by the T3 slice; the platform capabilities it consumes are named, not claimed.

value.objective: A request becomes a planned, baselined project.
value.detail: pm.plan and projects.baseline; the WBS and the scope baseline are the artefacts.

value.objective: No actor decides its own gate.
value.detail: Charter, baseline, change and closure gates each record a distinct approver.

value.objective: Scope changes travel as change requests with impact.
value.detail: The change register row, its impact block and its own gate; a baseline replacement reads them.

value.objective: A project closes only against its frozen record.
value.detail: The close gate's full read; the closure review is published before the close.

value.objective: Every decision is attributable and delegable.
value.detail: approval_decision rows with decided_by, kind and via.delegation_ref.

value.objective: Delivery cannot outrun the programme's authorisation.
value.detail: The start and close gates read the tranche's state.

artefacts.title: Data Entity Catalogue — T3 PM job (Phase C, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: List the entities the PM job writes or relies on, and the role each plays in the gates.
artefacts.scope: T3's persistence; reused tenant tables are named where the PM path reads them.

value.objective: The governed unit.
value.detail: Status, meta (track, adm_phase, closure_outputs), phase_code — every gate reads it.

value.objective: The frozen plan by kind.
value.detail: scope, schedule and cost kinds; approved_by is the distinct approver the gates require.

value.objective: The deliverables and their acceptance.
value.detail: kind='deliverable' with accepted status is the closure's deliverable proof; WSJF inputs ride the row.

value.objective: The gate and its decision.
value.detail: gate, target, status, meta.evidence; the decision carries decided_by, decided_by_kind and via.delegation_ref.

value.objective: The change, risk, issue, assumption and dependency rows.
value.detail: A change is a row with an impact block; the closure gate requires the four register kinds.

value.objective: The charter and closure assets the gates authorise.
value.detail: The gate's meta.closure_asset_id names an approved asset whose owner is not the approver.

value.objective: The published outputs the gates read.
value.detail: category, unit, published_at; the closure requires the declared outputs published.

value.objective: The authorisation the delivery reads.
value.detail: state authorises the project's start and close; the review authorises the next tranche.

artefacts.title: Technology Standards Catalogue — T3 PM job (Phase D, retrospective)
artefacts.purpose: Record the technologies and standards the PM job standardises on, drawn from the record and the proving suite.
artefacts.scope: Standards used by the T3 slice; no version is asserted beyond what the sources state.

value.objective: One relational store, compiled queries, explicit transactions.
value.detail: The PM path runs in one transaction per action; migrations carry the constraints the gates read.

value.objective: Tenant isolation at the row.
value.detail: Every PM table is tenant-scoped with FORCE RLS; `a_foreign_tenant_cannot_approve` proves the boundary.

value.objective: Every verb validates its input before the handler.
value.detail: The action registry exposes the schema; the invoke boundary answers 422 on a mismatch.

value.objective: An approval and the call it authorises agree by construction.
value.detail: Each destructive PM action declares approval_target computed from the input, never a copied string.

value.objective: A rule decision names the published standing delegation.
value.detail: assert_delegation_ref validates the P0 decision document; the decision records via.delegation_ref.

value.objective: The acceptance is executable, not prose.
value.detail: acceptance/programme/T3.toml names the checks; verify-project executes them against the live rows.
